# Real-data retrospective text diagnostic — November 8, 2026

## Outcome

Four registered real-data fits completed and independently replayed. Adding text reduced equal-fold Brier loss **0.2402279437% relative to the six-feature anchor**, with small improvements in both periods. Text achieved **8.2925872232% Brier skill against historical rate**, but was **1.9701400334% worse than the simple stage reference**. The paired text-minus-anchor interval includes zero. This is weak, inconclusive incremental evidence on a selected retrospective subset, not a forecasting validation or a 60% result. No model was promoted or deployed.

The study learned actual logistic weights from historical outcomes; it was not another synthetic test. It did not create autonomous self-labeling or an online updating service. Original E3 and paper gates remain blocked. Current introduced-edition renditions are not proven to match bytes available at the historical checkpoint; qualified reviews, complete negative evidence and global families remain provisional. This separate association study explicitly relaxed original human certification and reviewed-positive floors as computation prerequisites only, under the user's instruction to make decisions and carry out a bounded historical learning experiment. It does not represent those requirements as passed.

## Why this experiment

The [primary-source literature review](../../research/reviews/20261108-legislative-prediction-literature.md) found chronological legislative studies that compare structured context with added language. Other papers predict committee survival or floor action; their headline accuracy is not comparable to own-bill enactment probability. We retained the inexpensive matched text contrast, without adopting a neural architecture, new target or larger search. The [independent decision review](../../research/reviews/20261108-historical-experiment-decision.md) judged it coherent only as conditional retrospective association.

Question: on the existing current-rendition subset, does introduced-edition text add probability information beyond the six publication features? Outcome remains own-bill public-law enactment after day 180 and before Congress end, among legacy still-unenacted rows. Failed bills are genuine supervised examples where the existing outcome record says zero; this run does not certify their negative-source completeness. No final text, future status or labels are used as predictors.

## Fixed configuration and selection

[Protocol](../../research/RETROSPECTIVE_TEXT_DIAGNOSTIC_V1.md); [runner](../../../scripts/retrospective_text_diagnostic_v1.py); [independent helper tests](../../../tests/test_retrospective_text_diagnostic_v1.py).

Two arms × two folds = four fits, no calibration or hyperparameter search. Previously separate core/calibration rows are intentionally merged into a new training partition. Six structured publication columns use training-only population scaling, floor 0.1; text uses unchanged frozen structural preprocessing, source-preserving segments, administrative/focal identity masking, NFC/lowercase Unicode word unigrams/bigrams, min DF 5 / max DF .95, max 10,000 terms, training-only smoothed TF-IDF and L2 row normalization. Both text vocabularies reached 10,000 terms. Sparse logistic objective is mean NLL plus 0.025 sum(slopes²), unpenalized intercept, zero initialization, at most 20,000 L-BFGS iterations, accepted only with solver success and recomputed maximum gradient≤1e-6. NumPy 2.0.2 / SciPy 1.13.1 were pinned; six-hour cap, no retries/refits.

Rate baseline=(training positives+1)/(training rows+2). Stage reference=(stage positives+5×rate)/(stage rows+5). All four procedures score identical rows within each fold. Raw Brier is mean squared probability error; log loss clips probabilities only for numerical evaluation to [1e-15, 1−1e-15]. Primary aggregation averages the two period losses equally; skill is one minus the ratio of mean losses, not the average of per-fold skills. No calibrated-performance claim.

Source selection used the two existing outcome-blind training-coverage acquisitions, not new outcome-balanced sampling. The full 100-case pilot and its provisional families were excluded, protecting quality text. There were 1,200 nonpilot source documents, 1,195 unique candidates across the planned roles, and 1,186 prepared documents after nine fail-closed exclusions. Congress 117 lacked acquired nonpilot evaluation text and was omitted by readiness before scores; this does not redefine the original three-fold E3. Coverage-conditioned evaluation and prior development exposure prevent representative or independent forecasting claims.

| Fold | Candidate train | Accepted train | Training positives | Candidate evaluation | Accepted evaluation | Evaluation positives |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|115|544|540|11|300|298|10|
|116|848|843|17|300|297|8|

The 595 evaluation identities are595 provisional global families, with 18 positives; training appearances overlap between folds and must not be summed as independent families. Registration preceded preparation, final membership/exclusions were sealed before historical-label loading, and predictions were saved before computing their evaluation metrics. Training label dates and provisional family/identity separation were checked. No post-result population changes occurred.

Text's Brier reduction versus anchor is 0.342421160% in 115 and 0.122730482% in 116. Text improves log loss in both periods, but stage has lower Brier in both. All procedures underpredict total events in both periods. This suggests a small text signal under this fixed representation but does not establish a robust gain. Differences from the earlier calendar study cannot be attributed to features alone: population and calibration differ.

## Every preparation failure

All nine exclusions arose from `committee-name` elements inside substantive bill text. These are not proven corrupt source files: the frozen preprocessor conservatively rejects an administrative-tag name in a substantive position rather than erase potential statutory language. The resulting coverage bias is retained. No rule was changed or fit repeated. Any future correction requires a separate version and evaluation plan.

## Validation and failures

Independent pre-fit review produced 15 synthetic helper tests. Initial test fixtures omitted the newly required source Congress field and caused eight fixture errors; corrected before registration. Review also tightened source-period checks, bootstrap input validation, duplicate historical rows and explicit stage derivation from 4 ×the frozen first feature. The historical rows did not contain a separate stage field. These pre-run corrections are not hidden registered failures.

The registered run completed without failed optimization or serialization. Its nine preparation rejections are recorded above. All 641 full-suite tests passed in 85.477 seconds; 15 new tests passed normally and optimized, and 49 combined focused tests passed optimized. Independent post-run replay verified all 1,186 prepared seals, nine exclusions, two vocabularies/scalers, four objectives/gradients, 595 evaluation rows / 1,190 learned-model probabilities, reference probabilities, every metric/bin and all 10,000 bootstrap draws without further fits. Maximum probability discrepancy was5.551115123125783e-17. Its initial verifier launch used an incorrect runpy command and was corrected; no model was refitted.

Root checked 2,532 registered input/code bindings, all 6,427 inventoried prior files and the unchanged frozen-model audit. The lease was released. Docker was available and its running daemon verified; no container was created because the pinned tested local environment already ran this offline diagnostic. Container isolation would not establish historical source availability or erase exposure.

[Independent numerical audit](../../research/reviews/20261108-retrospective-text-diagnostic-audit.md). No experiment-wide elapsed time or monetary cost was recorded; the full-suite duration above measures tests only.

## Parallel literature and new-data work

Four primary scholarly studies were reviewed; read their distinct targets, splits, metrics and limitations in the linked literature report. A separately bounded BICAM investigation executed 10 direct metadata/range requests (6 HTTP 200, 4 HTTP 206), retaining 148,573 bytes, and verified 26 archive members plus three CSV headers. No bill rows were parsed or incorporated into this experiment. Three plans were sealed sequentially before their respective requests; later probes were adaptive. Its [dataset report](../../research/reviews/20261108-historical-dataset-options.md) and independent decision review preserve exact evidence, discrepancies and license limitations. Full archive checksums, real coverage and whether text fields contain bodies remain unresolved. Raw compressed prefixes may contain incidental data bytes; only headers were parsed.

The actual archive has 26 members while upstream code declares 22. The current archive is 1,936,532,215 bytes, so header/range inspection avoided an unnecessary full download. Author-hosted CMU historical bill data supplies another candidate stage-prediction corpus, but committee survival cannot replace enactment labels. BillSum final-text selection is unsuitable as introduced forecast input. No outside contacts or paid services were used.

## Next decision

Keep the stage reference as a serious comparator; do not promote the text arm or chase its tiny gain with more tuning on these 595 exposed cases. The highest-value next empirical work is a bounded outcome-blind corpus/version audit and broader representative historical coverage, with a separately justified design and all remaining provenance limitations explicit. Preserve language and context, add richer dated context only under a new fixed comparison, and distinguish committee/floor/enactment targets rather than combine them into one ambiguous label. Controlled learning uses actual matured labels at fixed retraining boundaries; self-generated predictions are not new truth.

The original historical-source and qualified-review requests remain unresolved. A prospective source-only ledger is still a separate engineering proposal, not activated by this study. The 60% target remains unachieved and unvalidated.
